title: “The Nations Condo”
description:
Welcome to “The Nations’ Condo” ! We are located steps away from local Coffee Shops, Restaurants, and approximately 10 minutes to downtown! Inside you will find modern living, minimalist design, and an open-concept kitchen and living area.The Bedroom has a queen size bed and the living room has pull-out sofa (full size ) to accommodate up to 4 guests. Free parking at the building.

The space
We provide everyday essentials such as; body wash, lotion, iron, full ironing board,blankets, towels, dishes, and other kitchen essentials. There is also a wash and dryer in unit and free WiFi
